crossRefs.note: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”
His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’ ”
But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”
Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

parallels.note: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send…

translations.web: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages, and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
translations.bsb: Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”
translations.kjv: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
translations.asv: send them away, that they may go into the country and villages round about, and buy themselves somewhat to eat.
